BiblicalUsage: Abez is a town in the land of Issachar, named once in the list of towns given to that tribe. Its name means something like I will make white, and beyond its place in the boundary list we know nothing more about it. The Bible still records it, because every town in the inheritance mattered.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that no place God gives His people is too small to be named. If He counted Abez, He counts the small corners of our lives too.
